verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document native MRR, churn-rate, cohort-retention, or LTV analytics computed inside Recurly. The closest items are adjacent: data exports used to 'analyze performance' (the bolted-on export path the story rejects), RevRec 'real-time insights' for revenue-recognition compliance, and a per-subscriber churn-propensity risk score. None of these is subscription-metrics analytics.

support.subject: As a founder, I get MRR, churn, cohort retention, and LTV analytics computed from the billing source of truth, not a bolted-on BI export
